project.name: VexelRay GUI :: Automation
project.description: Drives a real application the way a person does, for troubleshooting: a stateful pointer that never teleports, so hover and enter/leave fire because they were provoked rather than because something remembered to simulate them. Input goes out on the ordinary Tactroller topic, which is why there is no automation mode for the application to behave differently in. Speaks only bus message types, so the same code is a remote peer once the bridge lands. See docs/automation.md.
